value.text: Traveller! The Drowned Bell has been silent since the flood took the old belfry.

options.text: I'll find the clapper and ring it.

value.text: Bless you. Odd keeps the marsh gate key, and he will want coin for it.
Because the marsh will not let anyone rest until that bell rings again.
You rang it! Hollowmere can sleep again. Take my lantern, you have earned it.

value.title: A silent bell
value.description: Maren asked you to find the bell's clapper.

value.title: The marsh gate
value.description: Get past the marsh gate: pay Odd for the key, or persuade him.

value.title: Ring the bell
value.description: Find the clapper in Blackmere Marsh and ring the Drowned Bell.

value.title: Return to Maren
value.description: Tell Maren the bell has rung.
